section.content: In the semiconductor integrated circuit for using power gating, control input signal (SLP) is transferred to power switch (10) via transmission path (11), and is transferred to power switch (20) via transmission path (21).Restore decision circuitry (40) and receive the signal (SLP_H) of transmission path (11) and the signal (SLP_V) of transmission path (21), and generates control output signal (SLP_O).When control input signal (SLP) restore transformation, at the time of recovery decision circuitry (40) is later according to the recovery transformation of signal (SLP_H, SLP_V), control output signal (SLP_O) is made to carry out recovery transformation.

在采用了电源门控的半导体集成电路中，控制输入信号(SLP)经由传输路径(11)传输到电源开关(10)，并经由传输路径(21)传输到电源开关(20)。恢复判断电路(40)接收传输路径(11)的信号(SLP_H)和传输路径(21)的信号(SLP_V)，并生成控制输出信号(SLP_O)。当控制输入信号(SLP)进行恢复转变时，恢复判断电路(40)按照信号(SLP_H、SLP_V)的恢复转变较晚的时刻，使控制输出信号(SLP_O)进行恢复转变。

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of technologies of low power consumption for realizing semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technique

As one of the technology of low power consumption for realizing semiconductor integrated circuit, it is known to power gating (power Gating) technology.Power gating is such a technology, that is, for the circuit part not acted in semiconductor integrated circuit It cuts off the power, to seek to reduce leakage current.

In patent document 1, it discloses such as flowering structure, that is, for carrying out the power supply door of the dump of each circuit part Control switch series connection, the sleep signal for controlling dump are successively transmitted.

Patent document 1: No. 9,329,669 bulletins of U.S. Patent No.

Summary of the invention

Technical problems to be solved by the inivention-

In the semiconductor integrated circuit using power gating, when restoring certain circuit part from power off state, So-called dash current can be generated.So, for example, when restoring multiple circuit parts from power off state simultaneously, Biggish dash current will be generated in semiconductor integrated circuit, thus power supply potential is caused to decline, so that causing semiconductor A possibility that malfunction of integrated circuit, gets higher.

On the other hand, as method the problem of avoiding the occurrence of the dash current, it is known that connect power gating switch slowly Logical method, the method being successively turned on after power gating switch grouping etc..For example, leading under the structure of patent document 1 The delay for increasing each power gating switch is crossed, the power up moment can be made to be staggered, and the generation of dash current is made to scatter. But in these methods, there are the following problems, that is, the time needed for the power up of entire semiconductor integrated circuit is elongated.

The purpose of the disclosure is: the power supply for providing a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that can will use power gating is extensive The multiple required time inhibits shorter, and can inhibit the structure of the influence of dash current.

(first embodiment)
